latest_release.body:
Releasing Twake Drive 1.108.0 to production:

## New features

### Shared drives and sharing

- With federated sharing enabled, you can share folders nested inside shared folders. Drive asks for confirmation when reducing access also affects a parent folder. ([#4182](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4182), [#4196](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4196))
- Accept or decline sharing invitations from a banner without leaving Drive. Invitations appear one at a time, and unrelated banners are hidden on sharing pages. ([#4289](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4289), [#4399](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4399), [#4309](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4309))

### Moving and choosing files

- Browse destinations and create folders in the move dialog, including folders shared with you where you have write access. ([#4181](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4181), [#4190](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4190), [#4218](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4218))
- Connected apps can restrict file selection by folder, file type, size or count, and select files or folders without creating sharing links. ([#4282](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4282))
- Switch between list and grid views in the file picker. Your choice is remembered. ([#4426](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4426))

### Documents and AI assistant

- When enabled, the AI assistant can help write documents and presentations, or open beside the file list. ([#4285](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4285), [#4286](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4286))
- PDF editing in OnlyOffice is available when explicitly enabled. PDFs otherwise open in the standard viewer, and read-only access is respected. ([#4247](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4247), [#4441](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4441))

### Twake Space

- Open Drive inside Twake Space, with dialogs that can use the full page. Shared-drive file counts include subfolders when supported by the server. ([#4290](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4290), [#4299](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4299), [#4296](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4296), [#4397](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4397))

### Languages and performance

- Completed Spanish, German and Italian translations and corrected missing or incorrect French text. ([#4279](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4279))
- Reduced downloads to improve loading performance. ([#4278](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4278))

## Security

- Blocked unsafe shortcut links and prevented links opened in a new tab from controlling the original Drive page. ([#4186](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4186), [#4187](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4187))
- The OnlyOffice writing assistant sends its ready notification only to Drive. ([#4416](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4416))
- Updated libraries to address known security issues. ([#4255](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4255), [#4261](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4261), [#4276](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4276))

## Bug fixes

- Fixed opening shared drawings and PDFs from their owner's Drive and showing the latest saved changes when reopening them. PDFs also load correctly in Safari versions before 17.4. ([#4180](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4180), [#4219](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4219), [#4268](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4268))
- Fixed video playback on mobile and viewer navigation areas that interfered with file interactions. Unsupported videos now show a fallback instead of a broken player. ([#4436](https://github.com/linagora/twake-drive/pull/4436))
